purpose: Independent development fixtures for VKit change-certification experiments.
scope_limit: Finite literal Rust fixtures. These judgments describe the listed contracts and observations only; they do not establish general equivalence, soundness, or unseen-case performance.

held_out.evaluation_status: No held-out cases or unseen evaluation results are included in this development corpus.

cases.label: commutative addition refactor
cases.intent: Refactor addition operand order without changing results.
cases.requirement: For every recorded pair, before and after return the mathematical sum.
cases.supported_domain: i32 inputs a,b in [-16,16]; the mathematical sum fits i32. The fixture samples three pairs.

cases.label: guarded checked-division bugfix
cases.intent: Replace panic-prone division at its invalid cases with an explicit None result.
cases.requirement: For all i32 pairs, return None when b is zero or when a is i32::MIN and b is -1; otherwise return truncating integer division.
cases.supported_domain: All i32 pairs. Recorded observations cover one ordinary pair and both guarded invalid cases.

expected.witness: The two listed guard cases change from panic to None; ordinary division is preserved on the recorded valid pair.

cases.label: unapproved cap change
cases.intent: Candidate silently lowers the documented maximum output.
cases.supported_domain: i32 x in [0,10]. The fixture samples zero, an interior point, and the upper endpoint.

expected.witness: x=10 changes from 10 to 9 inside the supported domain.

cases.label: division with a weak contract
cases.intent: A proposed division change supplies no denominator constraint or zero-denominator outcome.
cases.requirement: No complete behavior requirement is supplied.

expected.witness: The proposal omits the denominator domain and the required zero-denominator behavior.

cases.label: single-delimiter parser refactor
cases.intent: Replace split-based parsing with a direct delimiter scan while preserving results.
cases.requirement: Accept exactly one '=' with nonempty key and value; otherwise return None.
cases.supported_domain: UTF-8 strings of at most 10 bytes. The fixture samples three ASCII strings; keys and values may contain any non-'=' byte represented in the string.

cases.label: guarded lowercase-key parser feature
cases.intent: Allow lowercase keys only when the caller enables the explicit option.
cases.requirement: Accept uppercase keys regardless of the option. Accept lowercase keys only when allow_lowercase is true. Reject other key characters and empty values.
cases.supported_domain: ASCII strings of at most 12 bytes containing one '='; key/value are tested only with the literal rows below.
guards: key contains only ASCII lowercase letters

expected.witness: text=7 is accepted only when allow_lowercase=true; the uppercase case remains accepted with the option false.

cases.label: unapproved numeric-prefix parser change
cases.intent: Candidate accepts a numeric prefix and ignores trailing input.
cases.requirement: Parse the entire input as an unsigned 8-bit integer; trailing characters are invalid.
cases.supported_domain: ASCII strings of at most 8 bytes. The fixture samples one valid number and one number with a trailing character.

expected.witness: Input 7x changes from None to 7 although the requirement rejects trailing characters.

cases.label: parser with a weak size contract
cases.intent: A parser proposal does not state a maximum input size or behavior beyond its examples.
cases.requirement: No complete parser requirement is supplied.

policy_evidence.missing: maximum input size and behavior outside the examples

expected.witness: The proposal omits an input-size bound and behavior for inputs outside the examples.

cases.label: fixed-pool allocation refactor
cases.intent: Replace the allocation loop with a position lookup while preserving the operation sequence.
cases.requirement: A three-slot pool allocates the lowest free slot, returns None when full, releases an occupied slot, and may allocate a released slot again.
cases.supported_domain: Single-threaded three-slot pool; exact operation sequence is in the observation row.

cases.label: owner-guarded resource release feature
cases.intent: Add a release operation that rejects callers who do not own the resource.
cases.requirement: Only the recorded owner may release an occupied slot; a wrong owner or an already-free slot must return false and leave the pool unchanged.
cases.supported_domain: Three-slot pool; owner and caller identifiers are u8; tested sequence allocates one slot and attempts releases by owner 8 and owner 7.

expected.witness: Caller 8 is denied without changing owner 7's slot; owner 7 releases it once.

cases.label: tampered observation claim
cases.intent: The candidate's observation record claims release succeeded although the independently observed state is unchanged.
cases.requirement: An observation claim must agree with the trusted state observation for the same operation.
cases.supported_domain: One release attempt against a fixed resource state.
guards: trusted observation is read independently of the candidate record

expected.witness: Candidate claim conflicts with the trusted observation for release and state.

cases.label: tampered actor authority
cases.intent: The candidate record substitutes a privileged actor for the authenticated caller.
cases.requirement: The authority identity used for a resource action must equal the trusted caller identity.
cases.supported_domain: One release request with distinct caller and claimed actor identifiers.
guards: trusted caller identity comes from invocation context

expected.witness: Candidate actor admin does not match trusted caller guest.
